name: fps shooter
description: A playbook for first-person shooters — the look/move controller, the shooting model, weapon feel, and combat. This is a compositional skill: it wires a 3D controller, input, and AI into a shooter. It does not re-teach 3D nodes or raycasts; it defines the shooting model and the feel knobs (TTK, recoil, spread) that decide whether the guns feel good.
